note: Supporting evidence only. /docs/ remains authoritative. Research candidates are NOT validated renters. No company has been contacted. Need for leads and willingness to pay ~$5,000/month are unproven for every company. Contractor offerings, hiring, and financing change often, so re-verify before any outreach or decision.

status_definitions.research_candidate: Identified from public evidence only. Not contacted.
status_definitions.contacted_candidate: The operator has had direct contact. Record date, channel, and outcome.
status_definitions.field_values: cipp_verified: true = the company's own current page describes cured-in-place lining; 'partial' = lining is mentioned but the method is not clearly CIPP. financial_ability_to_pay_5000: 'plausible' or 'uncertain' only, never 'verified' without direct evidence.

candidates.name: NuFlow Indy
candidates.service_area_note: Indianapolis residential service is verified. The homepage does not name Lawrence specifically.
candidates.capacity_signal: An April 14, 2026 NuFlow Technologies article describes NuFlow Indy growing from residential sewer lining into commercial, industrial, and large-diameter UV CIPP mainline work (Trelleborg PowerLight Pro, up to 72 inches). NuFlow Indy also has a municipal/stormwater rehabilitation page.
candidates.allowed_conclusion: Strong prospective renter candidate based on verified residential CIPP capability and organizational expansion signals.
candidates.limitations: Expansion evidence does not show they need homeowner leads; growth into mainline work could even lower the priority of residential leads. Financial ability is inferred from capital investment, not from financial data. It is also the strongest SERP competitor for Indianapolis head CIPP terms, which could affect how valuable they find a rental asset.

evidence.claim: NuFlow Indy markets residential trenchless sewer lateral repair (house to street) using CIPP in Indianapolis.
evidence.source_title: Indianapolis Sewer Repair Experts | Trenchless Sewer Repair | NuFlow Indy
evidence.evidence_summary: The homepage describes sewer lateral repair from house to street without excavation, using a CIPP pipe-within-a-pipe, aimed at Indianapolis homeowners.
evidence.limitations: Marketing claims about liner lifespan were not verified and must not be repeated as fact.

evidence.claim: NuFlow Indy publishes a technical explanation of its CIPP process.
evidence.source_title: How CIPP Sewer Lining Works | Sewer Repair in Indianapolis, Indiana | Indianapolis CIPP Sewer Lining | NuFlow Indy
evidence.evidence_summary: The page walks through camera inspection, cleaning, liner insertion and heat or UV curing, tie-in reinstatement, and a post-lining camera check.
evidence.limitations: Process description only; it says nothing about workmanship quality.

evidence.claim: NuFlow Indy advertises residential camera inspection, financing, and next-day service.
evidence.source_title: NuFlow Indy camera inspection and financing pages
evidence.evidence_summary: A camera-inspection page and a financing page exist, and 'next-day' service language appears on the homepage, camera, and financing pages. The homepage advertises camera inspections starting at a stated price.
evidence.limitations: Advertised prices and availability are dynamic and must not be republished as our facts.

evidence.claim: A NuFlow Technologies article dated April 14, 2026 documents NuFlow Indy's expansion into large-diameter UV CIPP mainline work.
evidence.source_title: NuFlow Indy Expands into Large-Diameter UV CIPP with Trelleborg Mainline
evidence.evidence_summary: The article describes NuFlow Indy moving from residential sewer lining into commercial and industrial work, investing in a large-diameter UV CIPP system (up to 72 inches), and completing a multi-diameter industrial project between November 2025 and March 2026.
evidence.limitations: Published by the franchisor (promotional). Says nothing about residential lead demand, staffing, or marketing budget.

candidates.name: Carter's My Plumber
candidates.service_area_note: Serves Indianapolis-area neighborhoods. Its locations include Greenwood, IN. The homepage mentions Lawrence once (context not assessed).
candidates.capacity_signal: An established residential plumbing company (family-owned, founded 1969 per company site) that is actively recruiting service plumbers. A third-party LinkedIn listing shows a 51–200 employee range (seen in search-result snippet only). The prior research claim that its own recruiting material states '50+ people' was NOT found on current company pages.
candidates.allowed_conclusion: Financially/operationally plausible future renter candidate with real residential trenchless capability.
candidates.limitations: General residential plumber with a trenchless offering, not a trenchless specialist. Recruiting shows scale, not a need for trenchless leads. The exact headcount is unverified.

evidence.claim: Carter's My Plumber offers residential trenchless sewer repair in Indianapolis, including camera diagnosis, resin liner (CIPP) lining, and pipe bursting, and supports online scheduling.
evidence.source_title: Trenchless Sewer Repair Indianapolis, IN | Carter's My Plumber
evidence.evidence_summary: The page describes camera assessment of trenchless eligibility, inserting a resin-coated liner into the existing pipe, and pipe bursting. It names Indianapolis neighborhoods and includes phone, scheduling, and contact conversion paths.
evidence.limitations: The page shows review counts and ratings; these are the company's claims and were not verified.

evidence.claim: Carter's My Plumber is actively recruiting service plumbers.
evidence.source_title: Service Plumber Jobs in Indianapolis Indiana - Carter's My Plumber
evidence.evidence_summary: The employment page recruits licensed service plumbers and lists three locations, including Greenwood, IN. A separate hiring post dated July 19, 2019 describes a 3rd-generation family-owned business founded in 1969.
evidence.limitations: No headcount is stated on these pages. The prior '50+ people' claim is unverified. No trenchless-specific roles are advertised.

evidence.claim: Carter's My Plumber has approximately 50+ employees.
evidence.source_title: LinkedIn company listing (seen only as a search-result snippet stating 51–200 employees)
evidence.evidence_summary: A search-engine snippet attributed a 51–200 employee range to the company. The underlying page was not opened.
evidence.limitations: Third-party, self-reported size band seen only in a snippet. Do not state as fact.

candidates.name: SLB Pipe Solutions
candidates.service_area_note: Lists Indianapolis, Bloomington, Evansville, Bedford (IN), and Louisville (KY). The only address listed is in Bedford, IN. Lawrence is not named.
candidates.capacity_signal: The careers page is recruiting field service technicians (part-time or full-time) whose duties include pipe rehabilitation, relining, pipe bursting, camera inspection, and drain cleaning.
candidates.limitations: Headquartered in Bedford, IN (southern Indiana). Response time and capacity for Lawrence-area residential work are unverified. Hiring shows workforce growth, not marketing demand. No public financial or scale data.

evidence.claim: SLB Pipe Solutions describes itself as a full-service trenchless pipe repair and pipe-lining company offering CIPP, pipe bursting, and camera inspection for residential and commercial customers, including Indianapolis.
evidence.source_title: Leading Pipe Lining Company Indianapolis, IN | SLB Pipe Solutions
evidence.evidence_summary: The homepage lists CIPP lining, pipe bursting, camera inspection, and drain cleaning for residential and commercial properties, with Indianapolis among its service areas.
evidence.limitations: The claim to be 'Indiana's only full-service trenchless pipe repair company' is marketing and was not verified.

evidence.claim: SLB Pipe Solutions is currently recruiting field service technicians for pipe rehabilitation, relining, bursting, and camera inspection.
evidence.evidence_summary: The careers page advertises part-time or full-time field service technician roles covering pipe rehabilitation, relining, bursting, camera inspection, and drain cleaning. It lists a Bedford, IN address.
evidence.limitations: Posting date not shown. A standing careers page may not reflect an open vacancy.

candidates.name: Modern Plumbing (Indiana Sewer Repair)
candidates.service_area_note: Claims Indianapolis and a long list of Central Indiana communities. Lawrence was not found on the homepage.
candidates.capacity_signal: Claims more than 15 years solving sewer problems in Indianapolis and Central Indiana, and serves homeowners, contractors, businesses, and municipalities. No headcount or scale metrics were found.
candidates.allowed_conclusion: Plausible technical-fit candidate. Scale and ability to pay ~$5,000/month are not publicly evidenced.
candidates.limitations: Its trenchless page mentions pipe lining, pipe bursting, and coating, but does not name CIPP / cured-in-place, so the lining method is marked 'partial'. The homepage does not mention lining or bursting. Scale and affordability are less publicly evidenced than for NuFlow or Carter's.

evidence.claim: Modern Plumbing offers residential and commercial trenchless sewer repair, sewer camera inspection, and hydro-jetting in Indianapolis and Central Indiana, and claims more than 15 years of experience.
evidence.evidence_summary: The homepage covers trenchless repair and replacement, camera inspection, and hydro-jetting across Central Indiana. It claims more than 15 years of experience and names homeowners among its customers.
evidence.limitations: The years-of-experience figure is a self-reported claim.

evidence.claim: Modern Plumbing's trenchless page describes pipe lining and pipe bursting for residential and commercial clients.
evidence.source_title: Indianapolis Trenchless Pipe Repair | Modern Plumbing
evidence.evidence_summary: The page describes pipe lining, pipe bursting, and pipe coating, with camera inspection, across Central Indiana.
evidence.limitations: It does not explicitly name CIPP / cured-in-place.

candidates.name: 317 Plumber
candidates.service_area_note: Indianapolis coverage verified. It has a Lawrence service-area page (https://www.317plumber.com/service-areas/lawrence/) that links trenchless pipe repair and pipe bursting, sewer camera inspection, and sewer repair.
candidates.capacity_signal: Describes itself as family-owned and locally operated. No headcount, years in business, or fleet size found.
candidates.allowed_conclusion: Technical-fit candidate with Lawrence-specific presence. Scale and ability to pay ~$5,000/month are not publicly evidenced.
candidates.limitations: Public evidence of organizational scale or affordability is weak. It also appears as a SERP competitor on Lawrence queries.

evidence.claim: 317 Plumber offers CIPP-style lining (epoxy-saturated felt tube), pipe bursting, and HD camera diagnosis to choose between methods, for residential customers in Indianapolis.
evidence.source_title: Indianapolis Trenchless Pipe Repair & Pipe Bursting | 317 Plumber
evidence.evidence_summary: The page describes inserting an epoxy-saturated felt tube, hydraulic pipe bursting with HDPE replacement, and camera inspection to pick the method, with residential homeowner scenarios in Indianapolis.

evidence.claim: 317 Plumber has a Lawrence service-area page.
evidence.evidence_summary: The Lawrence page exists and links drain and sewer services, including trenchless pipe repair and pipe bursting.
evidence.limitations: Page content depth was not assessed. The site blocks non-browser fetches, so it was verified in the browser.
